## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged Tier 4 biopsy with a single-class conformal set, backbone agreement, and high image reliability [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 100%, Invasive 0%, others 0% | Strong benign score (ECE 5%) |
| Conformal set | Benign (10% alpha, 90% coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 52% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical image quality, unflagged input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent models match each other |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign (80%), 1/5 Normal [F5] | Neighbors match benign or normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.55, contribution -0.992) pushes against invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.78, contribution -0.816) favors gland architecture [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Below-typical score (-0.06, contribution +0.539); descriptive context only [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Low score (contribution -0.233), but failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell fraction and nuclear size** (regions 0, 9, 10) · context · 77% tumor fraction (97th percentile) [F7], 42 µm² nuclei (0th) [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions beat random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); ignore unreliable mitoses (0/20), lobules (0/20), and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Crowded small cells in regions 0, 9, 10 (3177/mm² density [F8], 93rd-percentile size variation [F10]) represent low-grade neoplasia.
- Prominent tubules in regions 5, 7, 9 reflect well-differentiated tubular neoplasia rather than benign glands or normal tissue (`BACH_0381`).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 9, 10**: Verify crowded small cells and immune proximity [F11] are benign epithelium, not low-grade neoplasia.
2. **Regions 5, 7, 9**: Confirm benign two-layered tubule architecture without stromal invasion or nuclear pleomorphism.
3. **Region 6**: Inspect ducts (highest duct-confined score, 0.99; Weak 12/20) to exclude intraductal atypia.
